description: Statistics ops view: KPIs, modification/age/sample hotspots, filtered UPDATE STATISTICS queue, inventory, and per-DB rollup. Collector flags mod>=1000 OR age>7d OR NULL last_updated. TOP 80 sample - not full inventory.

targets.expr: count(count by (instance) (mssql_stats_age_seconds{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", db=~"${db:regex}"})) or vector(0)
count(count by (instance, db) (mssql_stats_age_seconds{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", db=~"${db:regex}"})) or vector(0)

count((mssql_stats_sample_percent{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", db=~"${db:regex}"} > 0 and mssql_stats_sample_percent{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", db=~"${db:regex}"} < 10)) or vector(0)

panels.title: Action Queue (filter with Min Modifications / Min Age days)

targets.expr: max by (instance, db, schema_name, table_name, stats_name) (mssql_stats_modification_counter{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", db=~"${db:regex}"} and on(instance, db, schema_name, table_name, stats_name) ((mssql_stats_modification_counter{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", db=~"${db:regex}"} >= ${min_modifications}) or (mssql_stats_age_seconds{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", db=~"${db:regex}"} >= ${min_age_days} * 86400)))

max by (instance, db, schema_name, table_name, stats_name) (mssql_stats_age_seconds{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", db=~"${db:regex}"} and on(instance, db, schema_name, table_name, stats_name) ((mssql_stats_modification_counter{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", db=~"${db:regex}"} >= ${min_modifications}) or (mssql_stats_age_seconds{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", db=~"${db:regex}"} >= ${min_age_days} * 86400)))
